messages:
elaine: Heads up — planning a blue/green for router config tonight 23:00 UTC. Target: v2.3.1 (routing + cookie fix). Need quick callouts on session stickiness, drain, and surge behavior.
rob: Do we want to pin users to old cluster for 1h after cutover? avoids reauth churn.
cheng: yes pin for 30m-1h. also enable soft-drain on old pool (graceful close) — set max-conns drain window to 120s.
miguel: rollout plan idea: linear 1% -> 5% -> 15% -> 50% -> 100% with 5m probes at each step. watch p95 and error-rate.
anya: rollback triggers? suggest auto-abort if 5xx rate > 0.8% over 5m or p95 increases > 250ms over baseline.
elaine: agree. add latency bump + user-facing errors. we prefer automatic rollback + manual alert.
rob: also ensure cookie TTL on new router is 7d and that it honors SameSite for our embed flows.
cheng: config snippet for ops console: ```
rollout:
  strategy: linear
  steps: [1,5,15,50,100]
  step_delay: 300s
  rollback_triggers:
    - metric: http_5xx_rate
      threshold: 0.008
      window: 300s
    - metric: p95_latency_ms
      threshold_pct: 250
      window: 300s
session:
  cookie_ttl: 604800
  drain_timeout: 120s
```
deploy-bot: Started rollout rb-20260321-11; canary=1%; pinned_version=v2.3.1; strategy=linear; steps=[1,5,15,50,100]; next_step_in=5m :rocket:
miguel: launching probes: synthetic traffic to /health + end-to-end session test to ensure stickiness. I'll post results every step.
anya: add abort playbook link in release notes pls: https://internal/release-playbooks/bluegreen-rollback.md :eyes:
rob: reminder: update CHANGELOG and notify infra slack at 22:30 UTC for standby.
elaine: we'll hold for 10m after 50% before final. if all green, finish, otherwise rollback.
cheng: if rollout-abort happens, old pool stays at 100% and we run immediate drain-lift on green.
deploy-bot: Canary step complete: canary=1% -> metrics: 5xx=0.02%, p95 delta=+18ms. Proceeding to 5% in 30s.
miguel: 5% probes running — added extra traffic to embed flow. looks fine so far.
anya: :thumbsup: good call on TTL. also add note in release notes about session pin window and how to manually unpin.
elaine: thanks all. keep chatter to this thread for decisions. if we need manual rollback, ping @cheng + deploy-bot /rollout abort.
rob: pinging infra: @oncall-infra please stand by at 22:50 UTC.
deploy-bot: Rollout paused at 50% (manual hold). next_step_in: manual_review.
cheng: I'll run a quick cookie sweep and confirm no split-brain. back in 3.
miguel: logging snapshots at each step saved to s3://redwood-release-logs/rb-20260321-11/ :file_cabinet:
elaine: final decision: proceed to 100% after 10m hold if no regressions. otherwise rollback. :rocket:
